end.summary: Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised identifying 3D shapes by checking faces and curved surfaces. They correctly used the number of flat faces for a cylinder and recognised a sphere as ball-shaped. They mixed up a box and a cube; this was revisited with an eent (brick), but the cube-versus-cuboid distinction was not fully corrected. They also thought turning a cone changed its name, then corrected this by noticing the tip and circular base; at home, compare a dice and a brick and check whether all faces are equal squares.
